jobDescription: Evaluate one normalized unsigned Base transaction against the buyer's exact policy at a declared immutable block anchor, returning a deterministic clause-by-clause PASS, FAIL, or ESCALATE receipt before signing.
pilotPurpose: Validate one complete operational lifecycle: separate-operator authorization, discovery, purchase, job admission, deterministic execution, delivery, and platform settlement receipt.
pricingRole: authorization-fixed operational test fixture only; excluded from market pricing, demand inference, willingness-to-pay inference, and production price formation

virtualsRegistration.name: pre_sign_transaction_policy_conformance
virtualsRegistration.description: Deterministically evaluate one unsigned Base transaction against the buyer's declared policy and immutable block anchor. Returns a replayable clause-by-clause PASS, FAIL, or ESCALATE receipt. Never accepts keys, signatures, custody, or broadcast authority.

request.description: One exact BasePreSignConformanceRequest v1; the runtime applies stricter canonical shape, authority-refusal, and resource limits.

requirements.request: BasePreSignConformanceRequest v1 JSON; no mnemonic, private key, signature, signed transaction, custody, signing, or broadcast grant

deliverables.receipt: BasePreSignPolicyConformanceReceipt v1 JSON with content identity, exact engine source identity, per-clause results, verdict, evidence references, and replay instructions
deliverables.assurance: Customer-declared block anchor and evidence are explicitly labeled unverified
